name: The Tomorrow's Theory
source:
The main character is finding himself in a weird situation : why does his neighbour act so strangely ?
He decides to talk to him for the first time in his life without knowing the consequences of this choice !
translation:
主人公发现自己陷入了奇怪的状况：邻居为什么表现得如此反常？
他决定平生第一次主动和邻居交谈，却不知道这个选择会带来什么后果！
